description:
Find existing, licence-cleared code (functions, classes, handlers, modules) mined from real
    open-source repositories, before writing it from scratch. Cost: 0 credits (free). Works without
    an API key with a small per-network limit; a free key raises the limits.

    Every result is licence-cleared with attribution: its SPDX licence, copyright holder and a
    GitHub permalink come with it.

    Parameters: query (required) -- describe the job in plain words, e.g. "verify stripe webhook
    signature in python". limit -- results per page (default 8; capped by plan). category -- a
    function tag from list_categories, e.g. "auth". language -- python, typescript, javascript,
    go, rust, java, ... . license -- 'permissive' (MIT/BSD/Apache/ISC; use it when the code goes
    into a product), 'commercial-safe' (adds weak copyleft such as MPL-2.0), 'open-source' or
    'any' (default). min_composite -- minimum 0-10 quality score, e.g. 7. offset -- pagination.
    max_per_repo -- cap per source repo (0 = no cap). exclude_vulnerable -- Pro: drop components
    whose imported npm/PyPI libraries' latest release has a known high/critical advisory.

    Returns JSON {"results": [...]}, each with id, name, description, repo, path, language,
    license, composite and five sub-scores, similarity and permalink. No code body: pass the id
    to get_component for the source.

    Example: search_components(query="express jwt auth middleware", language="javascript",
    license="permissive", min_composite=7)
name: search_components
title: Search licence-cleared components
